You specify the following information when you create a snapshot:
• The name of your snapshot repository
• A name for the snapshot
The examples in this chapter use curl, a common HTTP client, for convenience and brevity. To pass
a username and password to your curl request, see the Getting started tutorial.
If your access policies specify users or roles, you must sign your snapshot requests. For curl, you can
use the --aws-sigv4 option with version 7.75.0 or later. You can also use the commented-out
examples in the sample Python client to make signed HTTP requests to the same endpoints that
the curl commands use.
To take a manual snapshot, perform the following steps:
1.
You can't take a snapshot if one is currently in progress. To check, run the following command:
curl -XGET 'domain-endpoint/_snapshot/_status'
2.
Run the following command to take a manual snapshot:
curl -XPUT 'domain-endpoint/_snapshot/repository-name/snapshot-name'
To include or exclude certain indexes and specify other settings, add a request body. For the
request structure, see Take snapshots in the OpenSearch documentation.
Note
The time required to take a snapshot increases with the size of the OpenSearch Service
domain. Long-running snapshot operations sometimes encounter the following error: 504
GATEWAY_TIMEOUT. You can typically ignore these errors and wait for the operation to
